hook: Every hair follows its own cycle of growth, regression, rest and release: a new hair starts in the same follicle and pushes the old one out, and because follicles keep different schedules, losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal.

titles.text: Every Hair Keeps Its Own Schedule
What Happens After a Hair Falls?
